protocol: Check output absence, all reference bytes/hashes, trusted admission pin and current inventory. Require pinned connector result QUALIFIED, 16/16, unchanged code, gates False; no test replay.
Read unchanged manifest events in order; invoke process once per event; hash each payload before analyze; no deduplication.
Do not set historical gates. New admission gate only for open_session; all gates False afterward.
Maintain one session with no reset. Return immutable results without extra persisted full copies.
Check combined metadata allowance including referenced baseline before the next payload; close on actual processing failure, preserve complete evidence.
After regular close call verify_session_once exactly once; evaluate and compare only if technically valid.
No retry, changes or baseline rerun.

budget.classification: Native classes retain original attribution; historical record is counted in full, not as an uncharged digest. Stored JSON is uncompressed. All metadata subdivisions share 65536; success/failure are alternatives. Qualifying archives are not active inputs.

failure_policy: No functional partial evaluation. Full diagnostic and reached progress; no truncation to fit. Actual combined ledger overrides historical example sizes; exceeded limits stop the attempt.
